item.title: No Vector Store: a 25.87 MiB SQLite Index Reaches 86.62 Recall@10
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. The semantic call can wait until after the question arrives. Keep words and counts in the index, and MuSiQue R@10 moves from 54.41 to 86.62 on a 2.36-second build with no model calls. The paper is SAG2: Embedding-Free Multi-Hop Retrieval with BM25 and JEV, by Yuchao Wu at Zleap AI, arXiv 2610.
